facts.value: Licensed after September 1, 2020 with PMP access: 2 hours within 1 year of initial licensure
facts.quote: APRN licensed after September 1, 2020, and authorized to receive information from the PMP must complete 2 hours ... no later than 1 year after

facts.value: Board-approved geriatric certification may fulfill it; APRNs may use Category I CME
facts.quote: Board-approved certification related to older adult or geriatric populations may be used to fulfill this requirement. APRNs may use Category I CME

facts.value: Board-approved forensic certification may fulfill it; APRNs may use TMB approved CME
facts.quote: certification related to forensic evidence collection may be used ... CME in forensic evidence collection that is approved by the Texas Medical Board

facts.value: Certification requirement applies to APRNs who completed their program on or after January 1, 1996, or were licensed on national certification
facts.quote: This requirement shall apply to APRNs who: (A) completed an APRN education program on or after January 1, 1996; or (B) were licensed

facts.value: Initial registration cycle under 24 months: no CE before the first renewal
facts.cite: TMB, Continuing Education Requirements for Physician Assistants
facts.quote: If your INITIAL registration cycle is less than 24 months, you are not required to complete CE prior to your first renewal

facts.value: Licensed before September 1, 2020 with PMP access: 2 hours by September 1, 2021
facts.quote: APRN licensed prior to September 1, 2020 ... must complete 2 hours ... no later than September 1, 2021
